objective: Make cacheHome and the folders built from it in packages/runtime/src/setup/tui/load.ts join paths with the separator of the platform argument, so the setup-tui-load test passes on the Windows CI runner.
scope: Failure on the windows CI job (run 42627041951): packages/runtime/tests/setup-tui-load.test.ts:102 expects cacheHome({HOME:'/home/a',XDG_CACHE_HOME:'relative'},'linux') to be '/home/a/.cache' and receives '\home\a\.cache', because load.ts uses the host's node:path join while the function takes the platform as an argument.

Fix: pick node:path posix or win32 by the platform argument wherever load.ts builds a path from a platform-dependent function (cacheHome, guardedFolders, tuiDirectory and any other such helper), and judge an absolute XDG_CACHE_HOME with that same path module. Behavior at the real process.platform must not change.

Add or extend a test that fails on Linux without the fix, for example calling cacheHome or tuiDirectory with 'win32' and asserting backslash-joined output, so the regression is caught off Windows too.
